# Phrase smoke on the workspace test-app

Runs from a fresh install, starting at onboarding.

## QA

### Onboarding to the tasks tab

1. Tap the skip onboarding control
2. Tap the done control to finish onboarding
3. Wait for the welcome heading to appear
✓ The home screen welcomes the user
4. Tap the tasks tab
5. Wait for the tasks heading to appear
✓ The tasks screen shows the task count
